texts.847c87a7212c: The study population will consist of civil servants from different government departments who have attended screening examinations. Mortality and morbidity within the Civil Service will be examined and the study will alson look further at the role of social mobility, psychosocial and other factors in the persisting social inequalities within the Civil Service.
